name: SNeRG
aliases: Sparse Neural Radiance Fields with View-dependent Effects
definition: A method that reduces MLP evaluations to one per ray by decomposing the radiance field into a 3D field of densities, diffuse RGB colors, and feature vectors using a deferred shading model.
summary: SNeRG enables real-time NeRF rendering by decomposing the radiance field into a deferred shading model that caches diffuse colors and uses a small network for view-dependent effects.
